Download these 3 files by hand (right-click the link, "Save link as"). They are kept in
this folder so the site does not depend on an outside CDN at runtime.

1. https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js
   save as:  site/vendor/supabase.js

2. https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
   save as:  site/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js

3. https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
   save as:  site/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.css

If the browser opens the file instead of saving it, press Ctrl+S and save the page as the name above.
Check the update status of these libraries every few months.
